items.title: Pavilions We Loved in Venice
items.summary: Editor-at-Large Hrag Vartanian and critic Aruna D’Souza’s highlights from the biennale, plus six artworks inspired by the Odyssey.

items.title: National Pavilions We Loved at the Venice Biennale
items.summary: As the punishing heat waves of this summer taper off, this might be the perfect time to visit the international exhibition.

items.title: Six Epic Artworks Inspired by “The Odyssey”
items.summary: From J.M.W. Turner to Romare Bearden, visual artists have long turned to Homer’s masterpiece and the power of myth as sources of inspiration.

items.title: Beer With a Painter: Rina Banerjee
items.summary: “When you give up that power to the paint, it becomes your partner, helping you to make something beautiful,” said the Bengali-American artist at her studio in Dumbo.
